formatted_prompt: Painterly ink-and-watercolor illustration, richly pigmented, single focal subject centered on aged parchment with strong silhouette separation. A small weather-worn stone cairn stands alone on a featureless snowfield — three stacked slate-grey stones crusted with pale ochre lichen, surface pitted and frost-scarred. The cairn casts a long cold shadow in deep midnight blue (#0D1A2D) across clean blue-white snow. Faint aurora-green light grazes the uppermost stone's edge, a whisper of prismatic shimmer catching the polished facets. Sky is open pale ice-blue (#4A90C5). Surrounding snow is luminous white with cool blue undertones. Stark, contemplative composition, strong value contrast, black nib-pen outlines, saturated naturalistic color, square frame.
